title: Suspension of F2F classes at Tabunok Central School extended amid rising dengue cases

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu – Face-to-face classes at Tabunok Central School in Talisay City will remain suspended for another week following recommendations from health and education authorities amid the rising number of dengue cases in the school. Mayor Gerald Anthony “Samsam” Gullas said the decision to extend the suspension was based on recommendations from the City Health Office (CHO) and the Department of Education (DepEd) in Talisay City. The suspension, which was initially implemented last week, aims to give authorities more time to conduct assessments and carry out interventions to contain the spread of dengue among students.
